{{Quote|My comlink's not working, so I can't talk my way out of trouble if I'm spotted. Which means... I could get shot down.|Rachel's partner|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Rachel's partner''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. A partner and lover of [[Rachel]], he was making a delivery run of drills to crime lord [[Hallen (crime lord)|Hallen]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. Unfortunately, his [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] malfunctioned and he had no way to talk with [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] authorities of [[Belsavis prison]]. He managed to record one final message with a declaration of his love to Rachel before being shot down and dying in the crash.
